articles.title: A Soccer Star Is Stuck in Jail for a Speeding Ticket?
articles.summary: Homero Calderón, a pro soccer player from Venezuela, has been locked up in an immigration jail for five months. He was pulled over for speeding and arrested for driving without a Florida license. His family says he's very sad and missed his daughter's first birthday.

articles.title: A New 'Super Team' of Countries Could Be Forming!
articles.summary: Turkey's president says Egypt might join a new defense pact with Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan. The deal, called the Mecca Pact, says an attack on one is an attack on all—like a superhero team-up! It was signed last Friday in Mecca.

articles.title: Should Companies Be Allowed to Hack the Hackers?
articles.summary: President Trump wants to let private companies hack foreign cybercriminals—something only the government used to do. The plan would let businesses disrupt hackers and gather info, but many details are still unclear. Some experts worry it's a bad idea.
